an4.169:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.169:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:1.4: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.169:2.3: maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.169:2.4: so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati
an4.169:2.8: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:2.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.169:3.3: maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.169:3.4: so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati
an4.169:3.8: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā kāyassa bhedā sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:3.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.169:5.5: tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā diṭṭheva dhamme asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. kathañca bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati saddhābalaṃ hirībalaṃ ottappabalaṃ viriyabalaṃ paññābalaṃ tassimāni pañcindriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ
an4.169:5.6: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā kāyassa bhedā asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an4.169:5.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:5.8: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
